styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Elephants at the orphanage and giraffes at breakfast.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Markets, museums and the city's creative side.

styles.label: Adventure
styles.blurb: Day safaris and big views from the edge of the city.

stays.why: Central for restaurants, bars and malls. Easy pickup point for tours and taxis to most sights.
Green and quiet, close to the Giraffe Centre, the elephant orphanage and Karen Blixen Museum.
Leafy and calm near the UN and Village Market; good for families and longer stays.
Cheapest base and walkable to the market and museums by day. Quieter at night; take taxis after dark.

food: Try nyama choma (grilled meat) with kachumbari salad and ugali; order by weight and share.
Eat Kenyan-Indian food: samosas, bhajias and chapati are cheap and everywhere.
Carnivore near Langata is the famous meat restaurant; book ahead and check current prices.
Cheap eats: street stalls and small cafeterias serve a plate of rice, beans and greens for a few hundred KES.
Drink only bottled or filtered water; peel fruit yourself and go easy on raw salads at street stalls.
more_time: Add a day trip to Nairobi National Park at dawn; go with a guide and check park fees on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for the David Sheldrick elephant orphanage visit, which runs for about an hour in the morning.
Take a half-day to Karura Forest for walking and bike trails; go with a friend and in daylight.

recommend.why: Two nights cover the wildlife sights and the markets; add a night if you want a full day in Nairobi National Park.

month_notes: Jan: warm and fairly dry, about 9 rain days. Good for parks and walking.
Feb: one of the driest months, around 8 rain days. Comfortable days, cool nights.
Mar: still warm but rain picks up to about 12 days. Carry a light rain jacket.
Apr: the long rains. About 26 rain days and muddy parks; plan indoor sights.
May: rain eases but still about 18 wet days. Expect grey skies and cool evenings.
Jun: cooler and drier, around 9 rain days. Pack a warm layer for mornings.
Jul: the driest, coolest month. About 5 rain days; great for outdoor days.
Aug: dry and cool with about 7 rain days. Similar to July; busy season for safaris.
Sep: mild and fairly dry, about 7 rain days. A good all-round month.
Oct: rain returns, around 14 days. Plan mornings outside and afternoons indoors.
Nov: the short rains. About 23 rain days; expect afternoon downpours.
Dec: rain eases to about 16 days. Warm days and busy holiday season.

climate_guide.summary: Nairobi sits high, so days are mild year-round and nights are cool. Rain comes in two seasons: long rains in April–May and short rains in November.

items.title: Best time: January to March and June to September
items.text: Warm days around 23–27°C with the fewest rain days. Good for parks, markets and day trips.

items.title: Long rains in April and May
items.text: April has about 26 rain days. Expect heavy afternoon showers, muddy trails and slower traffic.

items.title: Short rains in November
items.text: About 23 rain days, usually afternoon downpours. Mornings are often clear.

items.title: Cool nights all year
items.text: Lows sit around 12–16°C. Bring a light jacket or fleece for evenings and early game drives.

items.title: July and August are cool and dry
items.text: Highs near 23°C with only 5–7 rain days. Pack layers; mornings can feel chilly.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light layers, a rain jacket, comfortable shoes and sunscreen. Add a warm layer for nights and a hat for the sun.

transit.best: Uber or Bolt for most trips; taxis where apps are slow.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail in the city.
Matatus (minibuses) are the main public transport. Cheap but crowded and can be risky; use them with caution.
Uber and Bolt operate widely; airport to centre costs about Ksh 900–1,500. Regular taxis take cash only, so agree the fare first.
Driving is on the left. Traffic is heavy, especially at rush hour. Only worth it if you're heading out of the city.
Possible in some areas by day, but not recommended at night. No bike share.
